verdict.rationale: Clerk exposes machine-to-machine tokens and API keys for programmatic/agent-to-agent auth (clerk-docs-11), a documented Backend API/OpenAPI spec (clerk-probe-3), and a CLI (clerk-probe-5, clerk-probe-1) plus an open-source scriptable migration tool that runs against the Backend API respecting rate limits (clerk-supp-migration-tool), all of which support headless/automated usage. However there is no explicit documentation of CI pipeline integration, test-mode/sandbox instances for automated test suites, or guidance on running Clerk flows unattended in CI. Missing for 10: explicit CI/test-automation docs, test/sandbox environment support, and independent confirmation that headless flows work reliably in CI.
